verdict.rationale: OpenClaw docs describe a sandbox backend for tool execution to reduce blast radius, and note Docker can be used for an isolated, throwaway Gateway environment separate from local/production installs — both support spinning up a non-production test setup. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'sandbox mode with mock/production-parity data' or guidance on testing agent behavior without touching real production data/credentials specifically. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox environment tied to test data isolation (vs. just execution isolation), first-party guidance on avoiding production data access during testing, and independent/hands-on confirmation the sandbox reliably prevents production data exposure.
